title: Huawei Cloud launches openPangu-2.1-Pro on MaaS with token pricing
summary: On November 15, Huawei Cloud added openPangu-2.1-Pro, which it describes as an open-source Pangu model, to its MaaS platform for agent development, AI coding, and inference optimization. Huawei says the model was tuned on more than 100,000 specialized examples for Skills triggering and tool calls, and is adapted to HarmonyOS ArkTS development and Ascend operator generation. It is integrated with AgentArts, CodeArts, and OfficeAce. MaaS inference is priced at RMB 0.8 per million input tokens, RMB 3.2 per million output tokens, and RMB 0.016 per million cached input tokens; the announcement did not give model size, benchmark results, or license terms.
